title:
Useful file tools.
Built around your device.
label: ABOUT FILECOMPRESSER
introduction: Compress, convert and organize files in your browser. No account, upload queue or watermark between you and your result.
seoDescription: What filecompresser is, how browser-based processing works, what the tools genuinely do, and where their honest limits are.

sections.heading: Processing stays here
body: Your selected files are processed in this browser tab. The page and engine code are downloaded from the application.

sections.heading: See the actual result
body: Original and output sizes are shown together. Already efficient files may not shrink; format changes can increase size.

sections.heading: Keep control of your files
body: Review settings, cancel work and save the results you need. Keep originals until you have checked the download.

sections.label: PRACTICAL LIMITS
sections.heading: Your device does the work.
body: Browser memory and processing speed vary. Each tool lists its input limits; very large or complex files may fail even within those limits. Media jobs have a five-minute processing limit.
13 tools cover supported images, GIF, video, audio, PDF and ZIP workflows. Some formats are lossy; PDF optimization is structural and ZIP extraction supports a defined subset of archives.

support.emphasis: Our guides explain formats, quality and file size.
